proposal.name_zh: 采集外观逆变换与解剖表征协同学习
proposal.authority_scope: User accepted moving away from posterior solver; current deliverable is complete evidence-led design, controls and one-shot stopping plan. No experiment launched this turn.
proposal.problem: scanner-related appearance shift should be addressed through a restricted acquisition-correction channel while retaining source semantic segmentation and supervision from current-domain anatomical labels; the original source can be wrong on current images, so old predicted masks are not hard targets.

data.source: existing Siemens train-L10 patients20 volumes230 slices; no new source U or additional subjects
data.target: existing Philips current train-L13 patients26 volumes254 slices; no old images/labels/features/replay or U/test
data.source_reference: same FixMatch43600 EMA163 native warm start, old saved23patient EDES score80.36740663770262% reused
data.validation: same old23/new31 repeated-development patients, no independent-test or cross-seed claim
data.clinical_scope: LV/MYO/RV2D segmentation with partial-volume boundaries and varying organ visibility; no assumed healthy shape or ED>=ES constraint

architecture.prediction: f_theta(C_psi(x)), real native3x3 classification convolution/padding/interpolation retained; no posterior decoder or per-image optimizer
architecture.canonicalizer: small image-conditioned estimator (three stride2 conv blocks1->8->16->16) predicts global8-bin monotone intensity map and smooth4x4 bias field; analytic inverse applied pointwise
architecture.semantic_network: original encoder plus prehead decoder; source phase trainable, target phase permanently frozen; original real final3x3 head fixed in both phases
architecture.anatomy_heads: training-only r32/r64 four-class occupancy heads; same spatial footprint centre as native output, align3x3 mean-patch prehead features through native output geometry before pooling; never replace native classification path
architecture.source_initialization: canonicalizer parameter outputs all zero -> identity intensity map and zero bias; semantic source weights from original checkpoint; newly random anatomy heads never affect deployed source initialization
architecture.deployment: one appearance estimator + one native segmentation pass; anatomy heads removed. Nonzero light appearance overhead disclosed.
architecture.identity_implementation_requirement: Use centred residual algebra for the spline inverse relative to fixed zero-parameter map; at zero output parameters values remain exactly identity while parameter derivatives remain active. No early return that suppresses training gradients.

acquisition_family.coordinates: no spatial warp, crop, object synthesis, or atlas alignment
acquisition_family.monotone_map: eight input bins width Delta=.25 on[-1,1], output widths=.5*Delta+.5*2*softmax(v)_i; v0 yields identity; slopes in[.5,4.5] for fixed parameters
acquisition_family.bias_field: upsampled4x4 coefficient field a; b=.05*(tanh(a)-spatial_mean(tanh(a))), so mean0 and |b|<=.1
acquisition_family.bias_forward: B_b(t)=t+b*(1-t^2); derivative1-2bt>=.8, endpoints preserved, output stays[-1,1]
acquisition_family.synthetic_transform: T_s(x)=B_b(M_v(x)); independently sampled fixed seed v_i and4x4coefficients uniform[-1,1] during training, one transformed view per clean input
acquisition_family.canonicalizer: C_psi(x)=M_vhat^{-1}(B_bhat^{-1}(x)); inverse bias=2*(x-b)/(1+sqrt(1-4*b*(x-b))), stable also at b0; inverse monotone map by piecewise linear interpolation
acquisition_family.bounds: Conditional on fixed estimated parameters, inverse Lipschitz <=2*1.25=2.5. This does not bound the total image-conditioned estimator Jacobian.
acquisition_family.medical_assumption: spatially fixed monotone contrast and smooth intensity field simulate a restricted acquisition-like nuisance; not a full MRI forward model and not proof real Siemens/Philips shift lies in this family
acquisition_family.information: synthetic forward family is invertible, avoids clipping information loss; correction parameters are inferred and may be wrong on real images

source_learning.views: clean x and independently transformed T_s(x), both retain original GT coordinates
source_learning.base_loss: mean over both views of ordinary pixel CE + present-foreground Dice (empty foreground Dice0, CE retained)
source_learning.occupancy_target: U_r=nonoverlapping average of four-class GT onehot at r32 and r64, captures fractional MYO occupancy rather than patient-average atlas
source_learning.anatomy_loss: mean soft-target cross entropy of auxiliary occupancy heads against U_r, averaged over two resolutions and both views; not class-reweighted macro CE
source_learning.full_loss: L_GT + L_anatomy + L_inverse; fixed coefficient1 for each normalized mechanism, no coefficient calibration/search
source_learning.base_source_loss: L_GT only, same canonicalizer+native network capacity, same two views, batches, optimizer and steps
source_learning.source_trainable: encoder/prehead decoder + canonicalizer; full source also anatomy heads; native final head remains frozen
source_learning.source_gate: both matched base and full-source checkpoints must pass original-source mean difference>=-.20pp, patientCI lower>=-.30pp, >1<=2/>2=0/p10>=-.50. Initial source function equivalence required; after learning only empirical source capability preservation is claimed, not exact function identity.

fixed_training_diagnostics.objective: each source configuration own full training objective and components; report task performance separately from reconstruction
fixed_training_diagnostics.stability_gate: last three EMA objectives adjacent relative change /max(1,abs(previous))<=.01; failure SOURCE_TRAINING_STOP, no extension

adaptation.source_to_target: freeze final source EMA native network and full-source anatomy heads; train only canonicalizer estimator psi
adaptation.loss_GT: same CE+present-foreground Dice on original and transformed current-L views
adaptation.full_anatomy_loss: same occupancy head against current GT U_r; source predictions are not pseudo-GT and no population average shape is imposed
adaptation.full_equivariance_loss: MSE(C(T_s x),stopgrad C(x))/(stopgrad MSE(T_s x,x)+1e-6), same current sample and fixed nuisance family
adaptation.full_loss: L_GT + L_anatomy + L_equivariance; coefficients1, one common physical optimizer step
adaptation.plain_loss: L_GT only; same transform draws and architecture
adaptation.teacher: no old-image teacher, no additional large model, no source-image context; detached current clean canonicalized view is same-model consistency target, EMA used for deployment only
adaptation.optimizer_proposal: SGD lr.001 momentum.9 Nesterov, matrixWD.0005/vector0, clipnorm1, fixed EMA.999; same for controls, no scheduler/EMA scan
risks: input/appearance-only plasticity may be insufficient for absolute83% new-domain gate
source anatomical probe can be inaccurate off its training support
global updates to psi can alter old images despite frozen semantic weights
target anatomy changes outside nuisance family remain unhandled

controls.purpose: base control, no studied source/anatomy/inverse mechanisms

controls.purpose: primary complete method; C-S measures complete adaptation bundle, no per-module causal attribution

finite_theory.invertibility: For fixed parameters B derivative>=.8 and M slope>=.5, both preserve endpoints; known synthetic nuisance has a unique analytic inverse without iterative solves.
finite_theory.risk_proxy: If fixed f and continuous surrogate loss are Lipschitz, |ell(f(C(T_s x)),y)-ell(f(x),y)| <= L_ell L_f ||C(T_s x)-x||. Reconstruction supervision directly controls this restricted-family term. Constants can be large, especially soft Dice on thin structures.
finite_theory.out_of_family: real domain shift may include spatial resolution, noise, missing information, anatomical distribution or pathology differences outside T_s; these leave extra error terms.
finite_theory.forgetting: ||f_s(C_psi_t(x_old))-f_s(C_psi_s(x_old))|| <= L_f ||C_psi_t(x_old)-C_psi_s(x_old)||. The right-hand side is unobserved during no-old-image adaptation; no no-forgetting theorem follows.
finite_theory.invariance: known paired synthetic interventions and GT supervision motivate task invariance. Does not establish causal identifiability or anatomy/acquisition disentanglement.

one_shot_validation_plan.qualification: initial native-function equivalence, inverse family correctness, monotonicity/range, native head freeze, source/target allowed-data manifests, finite full objective/backward, golden and nonempty checkpoint restore, two-case overfit, parameter sets; capacity failure stops rather than adding layers
one_shot_validation_plan.source_first: S0 and S1 each fixed2000 then each one source evaluation; both gates must pass before any target qualification/formal; no checkpoint selection or extended source training
one_shot_validation_plan.target: B/S/C each32 qualification, all before3x2000 formal; all formal completed before target performance reading

science.reference_rule: both own full-source and original FixMatch references retained; each source paired EDES patient bootstrap10000seed163; all gates required

one_shot_validation_plan.stop: One complete fixed candidate test only. Source/qualification/numerical failure stops. If final old-tail/new-NI conjunction fails, archive result and return to evidence-led method decision, no knot-count/bias-strength/weight/layer/probe/seed sweeps.

budget_draft_not_execution_authorization.binding_needed: before execution freeze actual two-view qualification/replay/reference calls, per-loss diagnostic gradients, inverse/transform operations, checkpoint/atomic peak and representative speed; cannot launch if original8h/<4GB cannot contain them

claims_and_limits: complete research candidate, not validated effective or TMI-ready
do not present restricted photometric family as MRI physics recovery
retain ordinary native output and target GT loss; learned auxiliary anatomy is training-only
do not claim separate causal benefit of each auxiliary term from B/S/C
single-seed pilot only; publication would require separately authorized broader evidence if pilot first passes
